title: Standalone lichend cannot provision any runtime GCP OSCORE peer
description: lichend loads durable TrustStore/GatewayCoordinator and calls Gateway runtime GCP ingress, but no daemon config or enrollment path invokes admit_gateway/install_gcp_context. SecureStack therefore has no context and every standalone GCP packet fails before dispatch. Extend existing TOML config with a spec GCP-3 closed-PSK federation mode and explicit peer public keys, durably provision/bind those configured trust anchors, derive collision-checked bounded OSCORE contexts, install them before entering radio loops, fail closed on invalid/ambiguous configuration, and add configuration/startup-runtime integration coverage. Open mode must remain explicit rather than silently unauthenticated.
close_reason: Verified the described capability is fully implemented and committed: TOML [gateway_coordination] with mode disabled/psk/open + explicit 32-byte hex peer_public_keys (config.rs:43-61); configure_gateway_federation runs before radio loops (lichend.rs:443-446, 496-542) rejecting stray material in disabled mode and refusing open mode rather than plaintext-fallback; provision_closed_federation (gateway.rs:1039-1099) durably pins configured anchors (TrustStore::provision_configured_peer, BrProvisioned, save_atomic_with_floor) and installs collision-checked bounded OSCORE contexts (install_gcp_context gateway.rs:985-1033, MAX_GCP_OSCORE_CONTEXTS=64, sender-sequence restore) before any GCP dispatch. Tests green: 18/18 lichend bin tests incl. closed_psk_config_provisions_durable_trust_and_runtime_context and disabled_and_open_modes_never_fall_back_to_plaintext. Completed the one remaining gap this round: documented [gateway_coordination] and [security] (rollback_floor_root, separate-mount requirement) in deploy/lichend.toml.example with accurate constraints (psk min 16B, salt/id_context max 8B, >=1 peer max 64, monotonic non-revocable pins, chmod 0600). 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness) found no P0-P3 issues in the diff; findings on pre-existing code filed as beads: tunnel_auth Revoked-vs-Replay test failure (P1), unknown-TOML-key silencing (P3), pin removal not revocation + partial-failure intermediate state (P2), open-mode enrollment path absent (P3).
